messages.subject: Project Marlin - kickoff and workstreams
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Elena,

We're on for the Brightwater Series B (Project Marlin). Westbridge leading £15m of an £18m round, Ravensworth £2m, angels £1m. £62m pre / £80m post. Birchall Stone for the investor (Oliver Jennings / Deepa Kovac).

James - take the subscription agreement and articles. Elena - disclosure letter and the cap table / funds flow, and keep the completion checklist live. Target completion end of January, longstop 27 Feb.

Watch the share maths: price per share is pre-money / pre-money FD shares - it should land around £16.07 and ~1.12m new B shares for the £18m. Keep every doc tied to that.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
